A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the starfighter type bar, the stat boxes, the game-text box, the icons and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:EJP-D-zuckussinmisthunter-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter]] (Decipher, January 2000): The game text now reads: “May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4 and adds 2 to power. Unless opponent has total ability &gt; 6 piloting here, reset opponent’s total battle destiny here to 0.” The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Zuckuss In Mist Hunter” and a white italic “E”.

The lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
